authority: Current user: integrate supported B shortage/published activity/employer/sector measurements and version new ranking treatments; keep working personal scorer
published_normalization: 100*log1p(source category count)/log1p(max count among all observed categories in same latest published source period); no missing-category zero imputation
source_precedence: Maximize personally assessed coverage across valid comparable groups; prefer latest published-category activity among equally covered assignments. Fall back to employer cohorts when a published singleton would strand an available comparison. Never pool unlike quantities.
shortage_handling: At most +1 for a code-backed related-group institutional shortage context; at most +2 only for a separately supported exact role designation. Unknown is no adjustment, never proof of no shortage. Nominated-title/child scope retained; publication/date window may be unknown.
sector_handling: Context only; no allocation of broad totals to detailed roles
missing_market: Independent rank scopes; personal-only/shortage-context fallback never full comparable-market completion
nullable_shortage_dates: Preserve edition label and null publication/fieldwork dates; availability is actual source/derived acquisition, not invented publication.
